THIS WRIT PETITION (PUBLIC INTEREST LITIGATION) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 16.10.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:78471 W.P.(PIL) No. 95 of 2025  2 Benny Varghese vs State Of Kerala on 16 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146222812/
1  JUDGMENT Dated this the 16th day of October, 2025 Nitin Jamdar, C.J.
Heard Mr. Sarun Rajan, learned counsel for the Petitioner and Mr.P.G. Pramod, learned Senior Government Pleader for the Respondent - State.
2. The Petitioner, who is running a hotel next to the Industrial Tribunal and Employees Insurance Court in Idukki District, has filed this petition to bring to the notice of this Court that the vacancy in the post of Presiding Officer of the Industrial Tribunal has not been filled.
3.

entities.text: Benny Varghese vs State Of Kerala
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
When the petition came up on board on the last occasion, though the learned State Attorney has pointed out that the Petitioner has a pecuniary interest in the matter insofar as the hotel business depends on the functioning of the Tribunal, and considering that the issue relates to the court establishment, we called upon the learned State Attorney to take instructions as to the steps that are being taken for the appointment of the Presiding Officer of the Industrial Tribunal.
4. The learned Senior Government Pleader has placed on record the order issued by the State Government, constituting a selection committee under Section 7A of the Industrial Disputes Act,
1947 headed by a retired Judge of this Court and the committee will conduct the selection process and prepare a list of eligible candidates to be appointed.
5. Considering that the process now initiated by the appointment of a 2025:KER:78471 selection committee will be taken to its logical end, we do not deem it necessary to keep this petition pending.
The petition is accordingly disposed of.

Sd/-
Nitin Jamdar Chief Justice Sd/-
